item.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll

item.title: Luxor raises $16M from CMT Digital amid AI-Bitcoin miner convergence

item.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant

item.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program

item.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
item.description: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit

item.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg

item.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank

item.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
item.description: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
